warnings: All callouts are ø = round bar SR-24 per S-01.
F2 and F3 mats print '6 ø9 มม.' and '8 ø9 มม.' — one count per direction, which way is not stated (count 14, direction not asserted).

C2 here ('เสาไม้หรือเสาคอนกรีตสำเร็จรูป ø0.15 ม.', drawn 0.15×0.15, plate 6 มม.) conflicts with S-02's joint detail (เสาไม้กลม ø0.20, plate 8 มม.). Section/detail sheets disagree with each other, so neither wins by rule; this file records S-03's own numbers and flags the conflict.

In every footing section, the 0.20|0.20 pair printed above the cap on each side of the column (from the column face outward) is not a pedestal or cap dimension derivable from the plans; left un-interpreted.
